feature_contract.goal: Correct projected car and rival rank markers' complete binocular shader-WVP source ownership, so head/eye-injected WVP from a prior car, road or viewport draw cannot displace the marker from its exact moving vehicle.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R84 shader-side projected rank/rival WVP and exact-ownership fallback are modified. Keep the existing original Calc3D2D per-car SpriteNode anchor, R84 XYZRHW path, NaviPub, world/GOAL/+TIME/lens/SkyGlow, original input and FFB, R26_SAFE, DX11 and frozen DXVK unchanged.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Previously R30 conditionally overwrote the live GetVertexShaderConstantF c64 with a proven raw game c64. Failure to prove source ownership silently left stale head/eye-adjusted GPU c64 in the binocular rank builder; this contradicted R30GetOwnedRankRawWvp's source-gating intent.
trace_stages: Original Calc3D2D source projects one car/rival anchor and associates the correct SpriteNode's stable producer, queue epoch and saved view-space vehicle coordinates.
The original game c64 write is captured in the R23/R29 owner; R30GetOwnedRankRawWvp validates current physical SpriteNode, shader identity/epoch, pose and bounded draw age.

R30BuildScreenSpaceEyeConstants now selects only finite exactly proved original game rank WVP to compose both XR eye matrices; failed shader rank eligibility returns before GPU submission and R33 preserves one native original draw rather than using cached road/world WVP.
subcomponents: Fix both rank and rival shader exact source WVP selection with one original-game matrix and correct two-eye scope, never fall back to a prior stereo-injected live shader matrix.
Preserve the native one-draw fallback when queue/shader/pose/raw WVP proof is missing or nonfinite, and keep the independent XYZRHW rank-anchor and other HUD/world paths unchanged.
Extend executable C++ rank regressions with positive exact owner and negative no owner, NaN, infinity and stale-live-eye scenarios, including Windows Release builds.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original car/rival SpriteNode shader rank source and final two-eye optical matrices
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both eye rank shader matrices derive only from one exact source-owned raw game c64. The previous injected live GPU c64 is retained solely for GPU-state restore.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Unowned/nonfinite rank, wrong SpriteNode/pose/shader and protected XYZRHW/desktop paths
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Unproved source never publishes partially modified rank stereo or borrows R29 world WVP; queued exact marker retains a native game draw while NaviPub, XYZRHW, road, SkyGlow and FFB remain untouched.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows R84/R26_SAFE game and x64 OpenXR host, active packaging, Domain and source regression
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Final exact-SHA GitHub DX9Ex Active, Domain Isolation, affected Full Source/HUD gates PASS without CI skip; Quest3/VDXR correctness requires separate actual HMD evidence.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R84 R30BuildScreenSpaceEyeConstants at prior HEAD used `if (R30GetOwnedRankRawWvp(ownedRankRaw)) memcpy(uploadedT, ownedRankRaw)`; false proof left live GPU GetVertexShaderConstantF c64 to be reprojected for car/rival marker.
diagnosis.root_cause: A best-effort raw game shader WVP override allowed a previous eye/world shader's injected live c64 to substitute as the original rank WVP when physical SpriteNode provenance failed.
source_trace: Game Calc3D2D records individual vehicle view-space rank anchors and exact original SpriteNode producer.
R23/R29 tracks raw shader c64; R30GetOwnedRankRawWvp rejects mismatched queue, shader epoch, pose or draw identity.
R30 rank shader eye builder now fails closed unless source-owned finite original c64 is present; R33 native queued marker fallback remains authoritative.
alternatives_rejected: Do not blindly copy live GPU c64 as original rank WVP, flatten markers to mono head-locked HUD, change source alpha/state, or rebuild protected XYZRHW original rank path.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R30 now requires original raw c64 before stereo; shared C++ selection validates all 16 components before atomic copy, while captured live c64 remains for hardware restore only.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Executable portable rank test runs no-owner, malformed NaN/infinity, and prior live-eye pollution rejection with unchanged destination; existing rank owner positive/negative and XYZRHW tests remain.
